description: Builds a terrain level from scratch. RESETS the whole map (calls newMap): fills Grass, adds a Forest border around the edge, a horizontal Road across the middle, and a grid of empty LandLot plots. Run this FIRST - the other terrain generators fill in the lots it creates. Final size = landLotWidth*landLotsColumns + 2*forestAroundMap (width) by landLotHeight*landLotsRows + 2*forestAroundMap + roadWidth (height).

forestAroundMap.description: Thickness in cells of the Forest border around the map edge (also used as side margin).

roadWidth.description: Width in cells of the horizontal Road across the middle of the map.

leftExit.description: If true the road opens through the left forest border (a map exit); if false the left stays blocked.

rightExit.description: If true the road opens through the right forest border; if false the right stays blocked.

landLotWidth.description: Width in cells of each land lot (house plot).

landLotHeight.description: Height in cells of each land lot.
